Agricultural Big Data Analytics System

End-to-End Scalable Processing of Indian Agricultural & Meteorological Datasets on Hadoop 3.5.0

1. Project Overview & Key Metrics

This project builds a fully verified, reproducible Big Data analytics system utilizing Apache Hadoop, HDFS, Python, and MapReduce Streaming. The system processes official historical datasets from the Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare and India Meteorological Department.

2. Dataset Provenance & Ingestion Specs

Dataset Publisher License Records / Size Coverage Status
Crop Production Min. of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare GODL / NDSAP India 246,091 rows (14.61 MB) 1997–2015 (33 States/UTs) VERIFIED IN HDFS
Rainfall in India India Meteorological Department (IMD) GODL / NDSAP India 4,116 rows (0.50 MB) 1901–2015 (36 Subdivisions) VERIFIED IN HDFS

3. Hadoop MapReduce Execution & Cross-Verification

Two distributed streaming jobs were executed on HDFS using Hadoop Streaming 3.5.0 with zero errors:

  • Job 1 (Crop Aggregator): Filtered headers, parsed CSVs, aggregated total cultivated area, production, and weighted yield per state/crop/year. Produced 12,986 groups. Verified against pure pandas calculation with 0.0000 maximum error.
  • Job 2 (Decadal Rainfall Aggregator): Computed 115-year decadal averages for annual and monsoon precipitation across 36 subdivisions. Produced 431 groups. Verified with 0.0000 annual variance.

5. System Limitations & Environmental Disclosures

Component Local Status Limitation Rationale & Mitigation
Apache Hive NOT INSTALLED Hive daemon not installed locally. Fully formatted HQL scripts (hive/create_tables.hql, hive/analytics.hql) are provided with OpenCSVSerde mappings.
PySpark SCRIPT PROVIDED PyPI lacks pre-compiled arm64 wheels for Python 3.9. Standalone script (src/pyspark/crop_rainfall_pyspark.py) provided with explicit schema handling.
R Runtime NOT INSTALLED R binary not found in system PATH. Econometric analysis script (src/r/statistical_analysis.R) provided for external execution.

6. Reproducibility Runbook

Execute the entire pipeline end-to-end using the following commands:

# 1. Check system and cluster
./scripts/check_environment.sh

# 2. Download and validate datasets
./.venv/bin/python scripts/download_data.py
./.venv/bin/python scripts/validate_data.py

# 3. Clean and ingest to HDFS
./.venv/bin/python src/python/clean_data.py
./scripts/upload_to_hdfs.sh

# 4. Run MapReduce and Python validation
./scripts/run_mapreduce.sh

# 5. Run EDA and generate reports
./.venv/bin/python src/python/exploratory_analysis.py
./.venv/bin/python src/python/generate_report.py

# 6. Run automated test suite
./.venv/bin/pytest tests/
